The '''Mission to Kashyyyk''' was a mission carried out by [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], to rescue [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], as part of his task to assemble an [[Army/Legends|army]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
===Prelude===
Once [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] was [[Skirmish on Cloud City|rescued and taken aboard the]] [[Rogue Shadow]], he informed Marek that [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|defeating the]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was a fool's errand. But, he did say that he had a contact in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] that might use Marek's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. But to get his aid, he required a person to travel to the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to retrieve an object that was very precious to him. If this was accomplished, then maybe he would be willing in helping Marek in creating a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] rule of the galaxy.

===Rescuing the Princess===
[[File:OzziksMeatshields-TFUComic.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Marek carving his way through the Imperial garrison.]]

Upon landing on Kashyyyk, Marek departed the Rogue Shadow alone, and made his way through Imperial controlled territory to find the person he was to rescue.

His task was to disable the comm tower of the base and to disable the containment shield. As Marek made his way deeper into the base, he encountered a member of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] at the quarters of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ozzik Sturn]], who was reassigned to Kashyyyk due to his extra-vocational activities as a hunter of exotic species. Marek fought his way into the compound to save [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the Imperials in order to gain the support of her father [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Senator Bail Organa]].

The Princess believed the intruder to have been an assassin sent by the Emperor, however, he made her realize that he had come to save her. It was then, that Marek realized that the [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Princess's father]] was feeding Rahm Kota information about Imperial targets. Princess Leia agreed to leave on the condition that Marek would destroy the [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|local]] [[Skyhook/Legends|Skyhook]], which the Empire was creating on Kashyyyk in order to transport the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] offworld for slave labor. When Marek stated that the Empire would simply rebuild it, Organa agreed that they probably would, but the Wookiees would at least have a chance to go in hiding. She then departed after asking if the shuttle was still outside the compound. Galen said it was, but the pilot was dead to which the Princess rhetorically asked why he thought she needed a pilot.

===Destruction of the Skyhook===
After contacting Juno, Galen was informed by [[PROXY]] that the destruction of the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] would accomplish the goal though the act would lead to an explosive violent reaction. Fighting Imperial troops, Marek attempted to realign the tractor beam emitters at the base of the platform.

While attempting to damage the equipment that maintained the skyhook, Marek came into conflict with Ozzik Sturn, who led the Imperial garrison force on the planet. Sturn piloted a [[All Terrain Kashyyyk Transport|modified]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], which he used against Marek, and he along with his troopers attempted to kill the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. However, they were defeated and the tractor beam was disabled, which in turn destroyed the skyhook. This act delayed the Empire's attempts at using the Wookiee's as a force for slave labor and gave them enough time to organize a resistance against Imperial rule. However according to Galen the Wookiees who remained on Kashyyyk only saw it to be rebuilt.

==Behind the scenes==
The Mission to Kashyyyk appears in Act II of the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]] as "Imperial Kashyyyk". The Wookiee characters that appear in that level are designed to be different that the Wookiee warriors and [[Berserker]]s that appear [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|earlier in the game]]; during the course of the story the Wookiees had been enslaved by the Empire, and the Wookiees look ragged to reflect this.<ref name="art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

The order of events differ between versions and media. In the video game, Starkiller lands near [[Kento Marek's hut]] and meets the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Kento Marek|his father]], then proceeds with his mission. In the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|comic adaptation]] he has a vision of the death of his father and his capture by Vader, before meeting the ghost of his father; then he proceeds with his mission of finding Leia. In the comic there is no mention of Sturn, Wookiees or the skyhook.

In both the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version and the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|novelization]] he meets Leia before finding his father's hut. In the DS version he defeats Ozzik Sturn, finds the hut and inside he has a battle with a Light Side version of himself before seeing his father's ghost; he then goes on to destroy the skyhook. In the novelization he has the vision of Vader's fight on the planet before killing Kento and taking Starkiller with him; then he is transformed into a [[Sith stalker armor|Sith Assassin]] and battles with a Jedi figure which he defeats, before meeting the ghost of his father. Then he proceeds with his mission.
